clips.send: Common mix-up: Measure the leftover in PIECES, not in wholes. In 3 divided by two thirds, four pieces fit and one third is left; that one third is half a piece, so the answer is 4½, not 4⅓. And flip only the divisor (the second fraction), never the first one!

clips.send: Another way to see it: dividing by 2 over 3 is two moves. How many thirds? Multiply by 3, so 3 becomes 9 thirds. How many groups of 2 thirds? Divide by 2. Together: times 3 over 2 , the reciprocal of 2 over 3 .
clips.text: Another way to see it: dividing by 23 is two moves. How many thirds? Multiply by 3, so 3 becomes 9 thirds. How many groups of 2 thirds? Divide by 2. Together: times 3 over 2 , the reciprocal of 23 .

clips.send: In general, give both fractions the same denominator bd , then divide the numerators: ad over bd divided by bc over bd equals ad over bc . That is exactly a over b times d over c : multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.

clips.text: 分数除法：为什么要颠倒相乘?

clips.send: 为什么这样算？把所有东西都用同一个单位—— 3分之1 ——来量。3 是 3分之9 ，一份是 3分之2 。9 里面有几个 2? 3分之9 除以 3分之2 等于 9 除以 2 等于 4又 2分之1 。分母相同，只要把分子相除。
clips.text: 为什么这样算？把所有东西都用同一个单位—— 13 ——来量。3 是 93 ，一份是 23 。9 里面有几个 2? 93 除以 23 等于 9 除以 2 等于 4 12 。分母相同，只要把分子相除。

clips.send: 还可以这样看：除以 3分之2 分两步。先问“有几个 3分之1 ”：乘 3，得到 9 个 3分之1 。再问“每 2 个一组能分几组”：除以 2。两步合起来就是 乘 2分之3 ，正好是 3分之2 的倒数。
clips.text: 还可以这样看：除以 23 分两步。先问“有几个 13 ”：乘 3，得到 9 个 13 。再问“每 2 个一组能分几组”：除以 2。两步合起来就是 乘 2分之3 ，正好是 23 的倒数。
